I am Lieutenant Drover of the Lionguard. Welcome to Charrgate Haven.
I am Prince Nekandezzar, Wielder of the Crimson Blade, the Grand Deceiver.
I am Thrulnn, the last ancestor of the last giant-king of the jotun.

I am a handmaiden to Her Majesty Queen Doran. I am here at her behest. Now that she is dead, gods rest her soul...one day, she no longer needs her hair done or her gown adjusted. I enjoy being useful.
I am at peace.
I am awed by the power of the stone.
I am busy. I cannot talk.
I am excited! It's exciting! I've read about places like this my entire life. My favorite books are about evil places and people venturing into them, and now I finally get to visit one myself!
I am not a mere street magician, nor do I take commands like one of your rotting corpse servants!
I am not at liberty to discuss that. I can assure you that all the ingredients are naturally sourced. When you are convinced, I will give you a concentrated formula that will permanently cure you.
I am not defeated yet.
I am of Clan Talonrend, previously a master bowman, but more recently, I've taken leave from those duties to travel the world and share my knowledge.
I am sorry for every loss you've suffered in this war.
I am the best. But fight Zhaitan? Ha. Mists and mortars, I've got my hands full with these ember spirits. I can't fight a dragon.
I am the general's new messenger. The previous messenger was...consumed.
I am the lightning!
I am too weak to go on.
I am unafraid.
I am under fire! Backup requested!
I am! Very smart, very clever. I keep many treasures, all safe. These are little. You can take, if you like.
I am. Thanks for asking. As requested, here is your usual merchant stock.
I anticipate that, at that time, the stone will cease to be strong enough to contain its magic, and it will rupture.
I appreciate the concern, I really do. Truly, though, I'm fine here. You're kind to think of me, but the best thing for me right now is exactly what I'm doing. Please, enjoy the festival.
I appreciate the support, truly. And in case you were curious, that's not a real seer proverb. I made it up.
I appreciate your discretion. The next clue reads, "Y'know, I had a cousin named Morgan. She used to make the worst mushroom soup. I still have nightmares about it... —April" Quite...vague.
I appreciate your note, and I'm glad you're as disgusted with this "treaty" as I am. If your White Mantle pledge to free Ascalon from the charr, then you have the Separatists' support. And mine.
I approve.
I ask that you keep the crabs away and bring me any driftwood you might find.
I assume you're well.

I believe this belongs to you.

I bet I can eat twice as many apples as you.

I bet you're expecting me to reveal Dragon's plan while we fight.

I brought you a vision crystal. Will you tell me about your kind?

I calibrated this aetherometer to pick up emanations of aetheric energy. Now we can find Orrian relics before Zhaitan does. This is odd...the signals seem especially strong over there.
I came here to trade fresh water for supplies. Now I need to return home, but we were attacked so many times on the trip down, we almost gave up.

I can't believe we survived.

I don't need your pity.

I don't understand how this technology works.
I don't want it. Ash politics are the only kind I care about. I like having equals to spy on. Makes things interesting.

I don't want to fight for Ash Legion.
I don't want to hurt anyone. I won't call her until I have her under control.
I don't want to pry.
I don't want to put innocent lives in any further danger from the Mordant Crescent, but I could use some cover until I can reach my hideout in the desert.

I feel strange...different...

I felt such a rush of wild magic, but then some of it seemed to just...flow through me. There's still so much I don't know.
I felt, feel, like I'm wandering.
I followed one of those pirates to see where they're stashing the loot. But by the time I caught up, it was all gone!
I fought beside him at Jahai, where he defeated Palawa Joko. I hear the Scourge of Vabbi has returned. This news breaks my heart.

I found these raven eggs. What should I do with them?

I gambled away everything I had, and then some.

I guess that's just business. Good-bye.

I had to follow the nonstop stream of charr expletives to track him down.
I had to stay late after class. Teacher caught me sleeping again. Had to scrub the drool off my desk.

I hate Dominion! Get 'em good!
I hate having others make my kills. It's not how I was raised. If I could do it, I would, but my mate changed things this morning.
I hate stepping in tar.
I hate the way this whole place smells. The sooner we can launch our invasion, the better.
